QuestInfo.name: Dangerous Mistakes
QuestInfo.0: #p1404005# is out cold. You should just get rid of him while you have the chance. Right?
QuestInfo.1: This was all part of #p1404005#'s plans! #p1404005# can only possess those of weak minds, UNLESS that person is near his physical form! He lured you here to steal your body!
QuestInfo.2: #p1404005#'s whole plan was to destroy Empress #p1101000# using Phantom's hands! How could you have fallen for his scheme?
